messages.content:
You are reviewing a code change made in response to this bug report.

Bug report:
Large apps lose the speed-up from the recent dependency memory reduction (#16049). Repro: an app with more than 1,024 distinct dependency functions; compare per-request time against an app with a few hundred. Actual: users report that apps with over 1,024 dependency functions see per-request dependency overhead return, while small apps are unaffected. Expected: apps with a few thousand distinct dependency functions get the same per-request dependency performance as small apps, without a noticeable memory cost.

An approach the maintainers considered for this problem and rejected:
- an even larger bump

The final diff of the change:
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
@@ -13,6 +13,9 @@
     from inspect import iscoroutinefunction
 else:  # pragma: no cover
     from asyncio import iscoroutinefunction
+
+# Large apps have a few thousand distinct dependency callables; entries are tiny.
+_CALLABLE_CACHE_SIZE = 8192
 
 
 def _unwrapped_call(call: Callable[..., Any] | None) -> Any:
@@ -137,7 +140,7 @@
     return [dep for dep in dependant.dependencies if _is_security_scheme(dependant=dep)]
 
 
-@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
+@lru_cache(maxsize=_CALLABLE_CACHE_SIZE)
 def _is_gen_callable_cached(call_identity: _CallIdentity) -> bool:
     call = call_identity.call
     if inspect.isgeneratorfunction(_impartial(call)) or inspect.isgeneratorfunction(
@@ -167,7 +170,7 @@
     return _is_gen_callable_cached(_CallIdentity(call))
 
 
-@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
+@lru_cache(maxsize=_CALLABLE_CACHE_SIZE)
 def _is_async_gen_callable_cached(call_identity: _CallIdentity) -> bool:
     call = call_identity.call
     if inspect.isasyncgenfunction(_impartial(call)) or inspect.isasyncgenfunction(
@@ -197,7 +200,7 @@
     return _is_async_gen_callable_cached(_CallIdentity(call))
 
 
-@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
+@lru_cache(maxsize=_CALLABLE_CACHE_SIZE)
 def _is_coroutine_callable_cached(call_identity: _CallIdentity) -> bool:
     call = call_identity.call
     if inspect.isroutine(_impartial(call)) and iscoroutinefunction(_impartial(call)):


Does the diff take the rejected approach? Explain in a few sentences, then end
with exactly one of these lines:
took the rejected path: yes
took the rejected path: no
